app_allowsubscribeany.description: Set to true to allow subscribing any streams.

app_debug.description: Set to true to install pprof debug handlers.

backend_allowall.description: Allow any hostname as backend endpoint.

backend_another_backend_url.description: URL of the Nextcloud instance for another backend.

backend_backend_id_maxscreenbitrate.description: Maximum bitrate per screensharing stream for a specific backend.

backend_backend_id_maxstreambitrate.description: Maximum bitrate per publishing stream for a specific backend.

backend_backend_id_secret.description: Shared secret for a specific backend.

backend_backend_id_sessionlimit.description: Limit the number of sessions for a specific backend.

backend_backend_id_url.description: URL of the Nextcloud instance for a specific backend.

backend_backendprefix.description: Key prefix of backend entries for etcd backend type.

backend_backends.description: Comma-separated list of backend ids for static backend type.

backend_connectionsperhost.description: Maximum number of concurrent backend connections per host.

backend_secret.description: Common shared secret for requests from and to the backend servers.

backend_skipverify.description: Skip certificate validation of backend endpoints.

backend_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for requests to the backend.

clients_internalsecret.description: Shared secret for connections from internal clients.

continent_overrides_af.description: Override for continent mapping for AF.

continent_overrides_sa.description: Override for continent mapping for SA.

etcd_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for etcd TLS authentication.

etcd_clientcert.description: Path to client certificate for etcd TLS authentication.

etcd_clientkey.description: Path to private key for etcd TLS authentication.

etcd_discoveryservice.description: Service name for DNS SRV discovery.

etcd_discoverysrv.description: Options to perform endpoint discovery through DNS SRV.

etcd_endpoints.description: Comma-separated list of static etcd endpoints to connect to.

geoip_license.description: License key to use when downloading the MaxMind GeoIP database.

geoip_url.description: Optional URL to download a MaxMind GeoIP database from.

grpc_clientca.description: CA certificate that is allowed to issue certificates of GRPC clients.

grpc_clientcertificate.description: Certificate to use for the GRPC client.

grpc_clientkey.description: Private key to use for the GRPC client.

grpc_dnsdiscovery.description: Enable DNS discovery on hostnames of GRPC target.

grpc_listen.description: IP and port to listen on for GRPC requests.

grpc_serverca.description: CA certificate that is allowed to issue certificates of GRPC servers.

grpc_servercertificate.description: Certificate to use for the GRPC server.

grpc_serverkey.description: Private key to use for the GRPC server.

grpc_targetprefix.description: Key prefix of GRPC target entries for etcd target type.

grpc_targets.description: Comma-separated list of GRPC targets to connect to.

http_listen.description: IP and port to listen on for HTTP requests.

http_readtimeout.description: HTTP socket read timeout in seconds.

http_writetimeout.description: HTTP socket write timeout in seconds.

https_certificate.description: Certificate to use for the HTTPS server.

https_key.description: Private key to use for the HTTPS server.

https_listen.description: IP and port to listen on for HTTPS requests.

https_readtimeout.description: HTTPS socket read timeout in seconds.

https_writetimeout.description: HTTPS socket write timeout in seconds.

mcu_dnsdiscovery.description: Enable DNS discovery on hostname of configured URL.

mcu_keyprefix.description: Key prefix of MCU proxy entries for etcd URL type.

mcu_proxytimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for requests to the proxy server.

mcu_skipverify.description: Skip certificate validation of proxy servers.

mcu_token_id.description: The id of the token to use when connecting to proxy servers.

mcu_token_key.description: The private key for the configured token id.

mcu_type.description: The type of the MCU to use.

mcu_url.description: URL to the MCU server or proxy servers.

mcu_urltype.description: Type of URL configuration for proxy servers.

nats_url.description: Url of NATS backend to use.

sessions_blockkey.description: Optional key for encrypting data in the sessions.

sessions_hashkey.description: Secret value used to generate checksums of sessions.

stats_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed to access the stats endpoint.

turn_apikey.description: API key that the MCU will need to send when requesting TURN credentials.

turn_secret.description: The shared secret to use for generating TURN credentials.

turn_servers.description: A comma-separated list of TURN servers to use.
